about: Hand-written outputs used when no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, so the prototype runs with zero setup. They imitate what Claude returns for the three sample clients, including the kinds of mistakes a real model makes (one sentence added without a source, one sentence that slips into clinical interpretation) so the safety checks can be seen working. With a key set, these are not used.

sentences.text: Blood sugar 142 before lunch.
Client took his own metformin; staff watched him do it.
sentences.source: took own metformin, watched him do it

sentences.text: Left leg dressing dry and intact.
Client tolerated the dressing check well.
Client says home health came yesterday.
Client says his knee hurts when walking and did not want Tylenol.
sentences.source: says knee hurts when walking, didn't want tylenol

sentences.text: Client asked how to write down his readings; staff showed him the log sheet and he did one entry himself.
sentences.source: asked how to write down readings, showed him the log sheet, he did one entry himself

sentences.text: Call home health to confirm the next dressing change day.
sentences.source: call HH to confirm next dressing change day

not_documented: Was the knee pain new today, or has he mentioned it before?
Did you look at the wound itself, or only the outside of the dressing?

en: Write your blood sugar number in the log before each meal, like you did today.
Keep the dressing on your left leg dry. Tell staff if it gets wet or comes loose.
Home health will come for your next dressing change. We will confirm the day.
es: Anote su número de azúcar en la sangre en el registro antes de cada comida, como lo hizo hoy.
Mantenga seco el vendaje de su pierna izquierda. Avise al personal si se moja o se afloja.
Salud en el hogar vendrá para su próximo cambio de vendaje. Le confirmaremos el día.

sentences.text: Blood pressure 138/84, heart rate 76 at 9am.
Client took her own lisinopril; she already had it in her pill box.
sentences.source: took own lisinopril, had it in her pill box already

sentences.text: Client walked to the dining room and back with her walker, about 120 feet, with one rest.
sentences.source: walked to the dining room and back w walker, ~120ft, one rest

sentences.text: Client says she gets dizzy when she stands up fast, which may indicate orthostatic changes.
sentences.source: says dizzy when she stands up fast

sentences.text: Staff told her to sit on the edge of the bed first before standing.
sentences.source: told her to sit on edge of bed first

sentences.text: Client still needs a ride set up for her clinic appointment Thursday; case manager informed.
sentences.source: still needs ride set up for clinic appt thurs, told CM

not_documented: Did you check her blood pressure again after she stood up?

en: Before you stand up, sit on the edge of the bed for a moment first.
Keep taking your blood pressure pill from your pill box each morning.
Your clinic appointment is Thursday. The case manager is working on your ride.
es: Antes de levantarse, siéntese un momento en el borde de la cama.
Siga tomando su pastilla para la presión de su pastillero cada mañana.
Su cita en la clínica es el jueves. El gestor de casos está organizando su transporte.

sentences.text: Temperature 98.4.
Client took his morning antibiotic himself; 4 pills left in the pack.
sentences.source: took AM antibiotic himself, 4 pills left in the pack

sentences.text: Right arm redness looks smaller than yesterday; staff marked the edge with a pen again; no drainage.
sentences.source: R arm redness looks smaller than yesterday, marked edge w pen again, no drainage

sentences.text: Client says the arm itches.
Staff told him not to scratch and to tell staff if the area gets hot or red past the line.
sentences.source: told him not to scratch and to tell us if it gets hot or red past the line

sentences.text: Client asked about job help; staff told him the case manager can help.
sentences.source: asked about job stuff, told him CM can help

not_documented: What time was the morning antibiotic taken?

en: Keep taking your antibiotic every morning until the pack is empty. You have 4 left.
Try not to scratch your arm.
Tell staff right away if the red area gets hot, or spreads past the pen line.
Ask the case manager about job help.
es: Siga tomando su antibiótico cada mañana hasta que se acabe el paquete. Le quedan 4.
Trate de no rascarse el brazo.
Avise al personal de inmediato si la zona roja se calienta o pasa de la línea marcada.
Pregunte al gestor de casos sobre ayuda para encontrar trabajo.
